items.t: IonQ (IONQ) Reaches DARPA Stage C With Its Walking Cat Quantum Design

items.t: IonQ Is Up 3% in a Week. Is Its “Industry Record” Guidance Really That Good?
items.sum: Key TakeawaysIonQ shares are up 3% in a week after third-quarter revenue rose 336% and it raised its 2026 guidance to $505-$515 million. Nearly half the quarter’s revenue came from a chip foundry IonQ bought in July, and rivals Rigetti and D-Wave rallied on IonQ’s numbers.

items.t: Rigetti Falls 5% After CEO Admits Quantum Can’t Yet Prove ROI; IonQ Sinks 8%, D-Wave Slides 5%
items.sum: A quantum CEO just said the quiet part out loud on an earnings call, and the sector's stocks flinched together. The timeline he offered stretches far beyond what growth investors usually tolerate, and a hot inflation print made it hurt more.

items.sum: IonQ is beating the odds, but a lot can happen between now and 2031.
